create_HolderModule: create a HolderModule to copy attributes from an original module to submodules that use those attributes
lift_subgraph_as_module: lift a subgraph into a new GraphModule by copying parent module attributes and returning a full-name mapping
compare_graphs: compare two torch fx Graph objects for structural identity including nodes, connectivity, inputs, and outputs
test_HolderModule: test the HolderModule class that wraps a dict of submodules and adds them via add_module
refactor_lift_subgraph_as_module: refactor lift_subgraph_as_module to support custom class naming and component naming for extracted subgraphs
